findings.title: Pod's ResourceClaim does not exist
findings.cause: the pod's resourceClaims entry gpu names ResourceClaim train-gpu, which does not exist in namespace kd-dra-claim-missing: the scheduler does not try a pod until each claim it names exists, so the pod waits with no condition and no event; Deployment trainer has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: pod claims gpu through ResourceClaim train-gpu
evidence.command: kubectl get pod trainer-74c6d97c6b-ppxqc -n kd-dra-claim-missing -o jsonpath='{.spec.resourceClaims}'

evidence.what: there is no ResourceClaim train-gpu in namespace kd-dra-claim-missing

findings.fix: Create ResourceClaim train-gpu in namespace kd-dra-claim-missing, or correct the name in the pod template. For a claim of each pod's own, use resourceClaimTemplateName with a ResourceClaimTemplate instead.
